title.zh-TW: 工作樹自動繼承主目錄授權，已允許的工具免再確認
title.en: Worktrees Automatically Inherit Approvals from Main Checkout, Removing Repeated Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在大型專案中切換不同分支平行修程式時，重複彈出的工具授權視窗往往打斷思路。現在工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）會自動沿用你在主目錄儲存的「永遠允許」決定，不必在每個副本重新對相同工具按確認。⟦拿著總部核發的通行卡走進各地分處，以前每換一間辦公室就得重新填表登記門禁，現在門禁機直接認可總部給你的放行紀錄；但只要你在總部被標記為禁止通行，所有分處也一律嚴格擋下。⟧如果你希望各工作樹維持獨立的授權，可以在設定檔寫入 `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` 關閉繼承。不過主目錄儲存的「永遠拒絕」設定無論如何都會一併套用，確保封鎖規則不漏接。
body.en: When switching between branches to fix code in parallel across large projects, recurring tool authorization popups often break your focus. Worktrees (a Git feature that opens multiple copies of the same project in parallel) now automatically reuse the "always allow" choices you saved in the main checkout, eliminating the need to reconfirm the same tool in every copy. ⟦Holding an access badge issued by headquarters, you walk into local branches: previously, every office switch meant filling out access logs again, but now security scanners directly recognize clearance records from headquarters; however, if you are flagged as barred at headquarters, all branches strictly block you as well.⟧ If you want each worktree to maintain independent authorization, you can write `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` into your configuration file to turn off inheritance. Regardless, the "never allow" settings saved in the main checkout still apply either way, ensuring blocking rules are never missed.

items.original: Worktrees also use saved "always allow" answers from the main checkout, so you are not asked again for a tool you already allowed there. Set `[features] worktree_inherits_main_approvals = false` to turn this off; the main checkout "never allow" answers apply either way

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示建議支援 Vim 模式，Tab 鍵改為切換瀏覽歷史
title.en: Prompt Suggestions Support Vim Mode, Switching Tab to Navigate Scrollback History

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在終端機打字時常會遇到輔助功能與快捷鍵打架的困擾。⟦切換到專業相機的手動對焦檔位，以前半按快門會直接觸發自動對焦，現在快門鍵改為切換畫面放大檢視，確認鎖定與取消則交給撥輪與退回鍵。⟧當你開啟 `[ui].vim_mode` 設定後，輸入提示建議的按鍵行為會完整配合 Vim 邏輯。此時按下 `Tab` 鍵不再直接套用推薦字詞，而是將焦點移至捲動歷史紀錄進行檢視。若要採納建議，改按 `→` 或 `Ctrl+→` 即可接受；按 `Esc` 則會直接關閉提示。
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings often struggle with helper features clashing with shortcuts when typing in the terminal. ⟦When switching a professional camera to manual focus mode, half-pressing the shutter previously triggered autofocus directly; now the shutter button toggles a magnified view instead, leaving confirmation and cancellation to the dial and back button.⟧ After you enable the `[ui].vim_mode` setting, prompt suggestions adjust their key behavior to follow Vim logic completely. Pressing `Tab` no longer directly accepts the recommended text, instead moving focus to the scrollback history for inspection. To accept a suggestion, press `→` or `Ctrl+→` instead; pressing `Esc` dismisses the prompt directly.

items.original: Prompt suggestions follow vim mode: with `[ui].vim_mode` on, `Tab` moves focus to the scrollback instead of accepting the suggestion. `→` or `Ctrl+→` accepts a suggestion, and `Esc` dismisses it

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式讀完背景工作輸出後正常結束，不再卡死停滯
title.en: Headless Mode Exits Cleanly After Reading Background Task Output Instead of Hanging

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程或持續整合環境中，排程腳本往往需要仰賴工具在背後默默處理繁重的分析任務。⟦快遞員將簽收單交還櫃檯，以前只要同一個櫃位剛好收走回條，人員就會愣在原地遲遲不肯離開；現在手頭工作一旦點交完成，便會乾脆地打卡下班。⟧使用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）執行 `grok -p` 時，以前只要背景工作或子代理剛好結束、且輸出在同一輪對話中被讀取，程式就會莫名卡死。現在無頭模式在任務完成後會正常結束退出，確保自動化流程順暢收工。
body.en: In automated workflows or continuous integration environments, scheduled scripts often rely on tools running quietly in the background to handle heavy analytical tasks. ⟦Picture a courier returning a signed delivery slip to the counter: previously, whenever that same desk collected the receipt, the courier stood frozen on the spot and refused to leave; now, as soon as the work is handed over, they cleanly clock out and head home.⟧ When running `grok -p` in headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal window), the program previously hung whenever a background task or subagent finished and its output was read in the same turn. Headless runs now exit normally after their work is done, ensuring automated pipelines wrap up smoothly.

items.original: Headless `grok -p` runs exit when their work is done instead of hanging when a background task or subagent finishes and its output is read in the same turn

title.zh-TW: 設定中的主題挑選器未按 Enter 離開時，自動還原既有配色
title.en: Theme Picker in Settings Restores Previous Theme When Leaving Without Pressing Enter

body.zh-TW: 當你在設定選單中逐一預覽各種介面風格時，挑選到一半若改變心意，常希望能立刻找回原先順眼的色調。⟦站在壁紙樣品架前翻閱花紋，以前只要把新樣本貼在牆邊比劃，店員就認定你要重新裝潢；現在只要未在訂單按確認，轉身離開就會立刻還原原有的牆面底色。⟧在 Settings（設定）選單的主題挑選器中瀏覽配色時，現在只要透過按 `Enter` 以外的任何方式離開，工具就會自動還原成你原本使用的主題。這項調整讓設定介面的退出機制與 `/theme` 指令保持一致，瀏覽外觀時不再擔心誤觸覆蓋。
body.en: When previewing different interface styles one by one in the settings menu, changing your mind halfway through often makes you want your familiar palette back immediately. ⟦Think of flipping through wallpaper patterns on a sample rack: previously, merely holding a new sample against the wall led the clerk to assume you were redecorating; now, as long as you do not confirm the order, walking away instantly restores your original wall color.⟧ When browsing color schemes in the Settings theme picker, leaving in any way other than pressing `Enter` now automatically restores your previous theme. This change brings the settings exit behavior in line with what the `/theme` command already does, so you never have to worry about accidentally overwriting your look while browsing.

items.original: The theme picker in Settings restores your previous theme when you leave it any way other than `Enter`, as `/theme` already does

title.zh-TW: 設定掛鉤時退出工作階段提速，結束操作更俐落
title.en: Quitting a Session with Hooks Configured Is Faster, Making Exits Snappier

body.zh-TW: 對於習慣在對話結束時自動執行清理腳本的使用者來說，每次關閉工具都要等待停頓常顯得拖泥帶水。⟦走出設定好離家自動化的智慧住宅，以前離家時得在門口等得較久，現在出門前的等待時間縮短了。⟧當你替工作階段設定了掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）來處理事件，以前輸入離開指令後總要卡頓片刻。設有掛鉤的工作階段現在退出更快，離開程式時更加俐落順手。
body.en: For users who routinely run cleanup scripts when a conversation ends, waiting through a pause every time they shut down the tool can feel sluggish. ⟦Leaving a smart home configured with departure automations previously required waiting longer by the door, but the delay before stepping out is now shorter.⟧ When you had configured hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) to handle session events, entering the quit command previously caused a noticeable stutter. Quitting a session with hooks configured is now faster, making exits much smoother.

items.original: Quitting a session with hooks configured is faster

title.zh-TW: 未按 Enter 離開主題選單自動還原舊樣式，反白文字永不變暗
title.en: Leaving theme menu without Enter restores previous style, reverse-video text never dims

body.zh-TW:
當你在終端機裡挑選介面外觀時，如果不小心按錯鍵離開，不會再被迫套用預覽中的樣式。⟦走進服飾店拿衣服在鏡子前比對，以前只要轉身走出試衣鏡前，店員就當作你決定買下並直接剪標；現在除非你明確走向收銀台買單，否則放開雙手就能穿回自己原本的衣物。⟧

輸入 `/theme` 開啟主題選取器後，現在只有按下 Enter 鍵才會正式套用新風格。只要透過 Enter 以外的任何方式退出，例如按 Esc、Ctrl+U、按 Tab 後按 Esc，或是開啟設定（Settings）與儀表板，都會自動還原回你先前使用的主題。

選單列中反白文字（reverse-video，利用字體與底色反轉來凸顯項目的顯示方式）在所有主題下都永不變暗，讓高亮選取的列始終清晰。這解決了在 Kitty 等終端機中使用 `terminal` 主題時，選單列說明文字過於淡薄模糊的問題。
body.en:
When choosing an interface appearance in the terminal, accidentally pressing the wrong key to leave will no longer force you to apply the previewed style. ⟦Picture stepping into a clothing store to compare outfits in front of a mirror: previously, simply turning away from the fitting mirror made the clerk assume you decided to buy and cut the tag; now, unless you explicitly head to the cash register to pay, letting go lets you wear your own original clothing back.⟧

After entering `/theme` to open the theme picker, new styles are now officially applied only when you press `Enter`. Leaving the picker in any way other than `Enter`—such as pressing `Esc`, `Ctrl+U`, `Tab` then `Esc`, or opening Settings or the dashboard—automatically restores your previous theme.

Reverse-video text (a display method inverting font and background colors to highlight items) in menu rows is never dimmed across all themes, keeping highlighted rows consistently clear. This fixes faint descriptions in selected menu rows when using the `terminal` theme in terminals such as Kitty.

items.original:
`/theme` restores your previous theme when you leave the picker any way other than `Enter`, such as `Esc`, `Ctrl+U`, `Tab` then `Esc`, or opening Settings or the dashboard
Selected and highlighted rows stay readable on every theme because reverse-video text is never dimmed. This fixes faint descriptions in selected menu rows on the `terminal` theme in terminals such as Kitty

title.zh-TW: @ 檔案補全反應加速，打字後更即時列出候選項目
title.en: `@` file completion speeds up, showing candidates more promptly after typing

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話框輸入訊息並想引用專案檔案時，常會輸入 @ 符號來尋找目標路徑。⟦在通訊軟體裡搜尋聯絡人，以前打完名字總要等游標閃爍停頓，才慢半拍列出結果；現在按鍵剛敲完，匹配的好友頭像就立刻呈現在眼前。⟧在對話中只要鍵入 @ 並接著輸入檔名片段，就能觸發檔案自動補全（file completion，根據關鍵字快速檢索專案檔案清單的功能）。例如當你想請 AI 協助修改特定程式碼時，鍵入 @app 就會跳出符合條件的檔案供你挑選。以往每多敲一個字元，候選名單往往需要稍候片刻才會刷新顯示。現在打字後會更快顯示出補全結果，挑選檔案時輸入節奏不會再被停頓打斷。
body.en: When typing a message in the chat box to reference project files, you often enter the `@` symbol to locate target paths. ⟦When searching for contacts in a messaging app, typing a name previously required waiting through a blinking cursor pause before results sluggishly appeared; now, the moment keys are struck, matching friend avatars appear right before your eyes.⟧ In conversations, simply entering `@` followed by a filename fragment triggers file completion (a feature that quickly searches the project file list based on keywords). For example, when asking AI to help edit specific code, typing `@app` pops up matching files for you to choose from. Previously, with each additional character typed, the candidate list often needed to wait a moment before refreshing. File completion now shows results faster after you type, ensuring your typing rhythm is no longer interrupted by pauses when selecting files.

items.original: `@` file completion shows results faster after you type

title.zh-TW: /resume 搜尋支援跨資料夾與對話全文，字首匹配更精確
title.en: `/resume` search supports other folders and full session text, with more accurate prefix matching

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續先前的對話進度，卻只依稀記得幾句回覆或執行過的指令時。⟦跟請唱片行店員尋找舊專輯一樣，以前只要打錯字母就找不到，也查不到內頁歌詞裡的片語；現在能跨架檢索整張唱片收錄的曲目與備註，還會嚴格對齊單字開頭，不再把不相干的黑膠混在一起。⟧現在輸入 `/resume` 搜尋時，工具能直接找出其他資料夾的工作階段，並能容忍打錯字。比對範圍更擴及工作階段內的指令、檔案路徑與回覆內容。輸入單一字元時會維持字面意義，搜尋詞則會各自對齊單字開頭比對，因此輸入 `log fix` 不會再配對到「Blog prefix cleanup」。
body.en: When you want to continue previous conversation progress, but only vaguely remember a few replies or executed commands. ⟦Think of asking a record store clerk to find an old record: previously, a single mistyped letter meant you could not find it, nor could you search for phrases in the liner notes; now they can search across shelves through the tracks and notes on an entire record, while strictly matching word beginnings so unrelated vinyl is no longer mixed in.⟧ Now when searching with `/resume`, the tool can directly find sessions from other folders and tolerate typos. The matching scope also extends to commands, file paths, and reply content within a session. A single typed character keeps its literal meaning, and search terms match individually at the start of words, so typing `log fix` no longer matches "Blog prefix cleanup".

title.zh-TW: 指令列指定 `--permission-mode plan`，依約進入計畫模式
title.en: Specifying `--permission-mode plan` on the command line enters plan mode as documented

body.zh-TW: 準備著手梳理大型架構時，你可能會先指定 Grok 的起始模式。⟦請建築顧問入場，以前明明約好從規劃會議開始，顧問卻仍照預設流程開場；現在他會依約從規劃會議開始。⟧先前在指令列加上 `--permission-mode plan` 參數，啟動的工作階段卻仍會停留在預設模式。現在這項問題已經修好，會依文件所述，以計畫模式啟動工作階段。
body.en: When preparing to untangle a large architecture, you might specify Grok's starting mode in advance. ⟦Picture hiring a building consultant: previously, despite agreeing to start with a planning meeting, the consultant still opened with the default process; now they start from the planning meeting as agreed.⟧ Previously, adding the `--permission-mode plan` option on the command line still left the started session in the default mode. Now this issue has been fixed, and it starts the session in plan mode as documented.

items.original: `--permission-mode plan` starts the session in plan mode, as documented, instead of the default mode

title.zh-TW: 儀表板 `Ctrl+L` 資料夾清單擴充，最近記錄上限增至 50 個
title.en: Dashboard `Ctrl+L` folder list expanded, increasing recent history limit to 50

body.zh-TW: 在儀表板頻繁切換多個專案，想快速跳轉到不久前開啟過的目錄時。⟦拉開工作檯旁的工具收納格，以前抽屜容量狹窄，最多只能保留 10 種最近拿取的工具，稍微切換幾樣舊工具就得重新翻找；現在收納上限擴增至 50 格，找回剛用過的器具不再撲空。⟧過去在儀表板按下快速鍵 `Ctrl+L` 開啟資料夾挑選器時，清單只會列出 10 個最近開啟的項目，切換頻繁時舊路徑很快就會被擠掉。現在選單能列出最多 50 個最近資料夾，翻找過去的專案路徑時不必再重複輸入。
body.en: When frequently switching between multiple projects in the dashboard and wanting to quickly jump to a recently opened directory. ⟦A craftsperson opens a tool organizer beside a workbench: previously, drawer capacity was narrow and could only keep 10 recently grabbed tools, so switching tools forced you to search around again; now the storage limit expands to 50 slots, so reaching back for recently used tools no longer comes up empty.⟧ Previously, pressing the shortcut `Ctrl+L` in the dashboard to open the folder picker only listed 10 recently opened items, so older paths were quickly pushed out during frequent switching. Now the menu can list up to 50 recent folders, eliminating the need to retype past project paths when browsing for them.

items.original: The dashboard `Ctrl+L` folder picker lists up to 50 recent folders instead of 10

title.zh-TW: `grok --help` 提供單行摘要，查詢說明指令不再報錯
title.en: `grok --help` provides one-line summaries, and inspecting the help command no longer errors

body.zh-TW: 面對陌生的指令列想查詢參數用法，快速掌握功能全貌時。⟦站在綜合賣場的入口指示看板前，以前看板沒有簡短說明，想按鈕查詢導覽機自身的用法還會亮起故障紅燈；現在各個專區都附有一行清爽簡介，點選服務台說明也能順利拿到導覽指南。⟧現在執行 `grok --help` 時，畫面會替每個指令與選項附上一行簡短摘要，方便在同一個畫面瀏覽完整功能。若輸入 `grok help -h` 或 `grok help --help` 查詢說明指令自身，終端機會正常印出 help 指令的說明資訊，不再跳出錯誤訊息。
body.en: When facing an unfamiliar command line and wanting to look up option usage to quickly grasp the full picture of features. ⟦Imagine standing before an entrance directory board in a department store: previously, the board had no brief descriptions, and pressing a button to look up how to use the directory itself would light up a red malfunction light; now each section comes with a clean one-line overview, and selecting the help desk guide successfully delivers the directory guide.⟧ Now when running `grok --help`, the screen provides each command and option with a one-line summary, making it easy to browse the complete feature set on a single screen. If you enter `grok help -h` or `grok help --help` to look up the help command itself, the terminal prints help information for the help command normally instead of throwing an error message.

items.original: `grok --help` gives each command and option a one-line summary, and `grok help -h` and `grok help --help` print help for the help command itself instead of an error

title.zh-TW: 停用遙測與當機回報，環境變數設為任何值皆生效
title.en: Disabling telemetry and crash reports takes effect when environment variables are set to any value

body.zh-TW: 管理重視隱私的內部專案，需要停用各類背景數據傳輸時。⟦在住家大門掛上拒收宣傳品的告示牌，以前只要標籤上寫了文字，郵差常誤以為在備註投遞細節而繼續塞入廣告；現在只要門前掛有告示牌，不論上頭填寫什麼內容，外送員都會確實停止投遞所有文宣。⟧現在只要設定環境變數 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 或 `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING`，無論賦予它們任何值，包含字面上的 `0` 與 `false`，工具都會確實將遙測與當機回報功能關閉。這避免了過去因填寫非預期數值，導致停用設定未能如期生效的情況。
body.en: When managing privacy-sensitive internal projects and needing to disable various types of background data transmission. ⟦A homeowner hangs a sign refusing promotional mail on the front door: previously, whenever text was written on the label, mail carriers often mistook it for delivery notes and kept stuffing flyers in; now as long as a sign hangs on the door, regardless of what is written on it, delivery couriers reliably stop dropping off all promotional material.⟧ Now simply setting the environment variable `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING` to any value, including the literal `0` and `false`, ensures the tool turns telemetry and crash reports off. This avoids the past situation where entering unexpected values prevented the disable setting from taking effect as expected.

items.original: Any value of `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING`, including `0` and `false`, turns telemetry and crash reports off

title.zh-TW: 未受信任資料夾限制執行掛鉤，無頭模式預設信任個人設定
title.en: Untrusted Folders Restrict Hook Execution, While Headless Mode Trusts Personal Settings by Default

body.zh-TW: 從網路下載開源專案或開啟陌生目錄時，潛在的腳本可能藉由自動化流程悄悄啟動。在未受信任的資料夾中，只會執行所屬組織集中管理的掛鉤（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）。⟦進駐管制嚴密的企業園區，以前未經認證的訪客攜帶自備隨身碟就能隨意運作，現在櫃台只允許使用公司統一配發的儲存設備，個人的自訂工具一律扣留，直到取得正式擔保才准啟用。⟧專案、外掛、代理人與使用者自訂的掛鉤都會暫停，直到你手動確認信任該資料夾。若是在無頭模式（沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）下啟動工作階段，使用者個人掛鉤則會預設為受信任，兼顧自動化腳本的執行彈性。
body.en: When downloading open-source projects from the internet or opening unfamiliar directories, potential scripts might trigger quietly through automated workflows. In untrusted folders, only managed hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) from your organization will run. ⟦Entering a tightly guarded corporate campus, unverified visitors once operated freely with personal flash drives, but now the front desk only permits company-issued storage devices, holding all personal custom tools until formal clearance is granted.⟧ Project, plugin, agent, and user custom hooks wait until you manually confirm that you trust the folder. If you start a session in headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal visual interface), personal user hooks are treated as trusted by default, preserving execution flexibility for automated scripts.

items.original: Untrusted folders run only managed hooks from your organization. User, project, plugin, and agent hooks wait until you trust the folder. Headless sessions treat user hooks as trusted

title.zh-TW: 自動模式指令完全比對允許清單，常用編譯版本查詢免確認
title.en: Auto Mode Matches Commands Strictly Against Allowlists, Skipping Confirmation for Common Compiler Version Checks

body.zh-TW: 開啟自動模式讓 AI 自主執行終端機指令時，安全邊界有了更嚴密的審查機制。⟦穿過海關的快速查驗通道，以前整批行李貼著免檢標籤便直接放行，現在查驗員逐件核對包裝清單，只要夾帶一項未申報物件就必須停下開箱，只有附帶原廠說明的標準樣品才能直接過關。⟧在自動模式（Auto mode）下，只有當整段指令中的每一個指令都符合允許清單時才會直接執行，其餘任何指令都會先向你確認。權限規則在解析時，會比照 bash 傳遞參數給程式的方式逐字讀取每個單詞，確保指令拆分與實際執行完全一致。為了不打斷工作節奏，查詢編譯工具版本的 `make --version`、`cmake --version` 與 `just --version` 已預設允許直接執行，不必手動確認。
body.en: When enabling Auto mode for AI to run terminal commands autonomously, the security boundary gains a stricter review mechanism. ⟦Picture an express customs inspection lane: entire batches of luggage once cleared directly with inspection-exempt tags, but now inspectors verify every item against the packing list, stopping to open any box carrying an undeclared item, while waving through only standard samples backed by manufacturer documentation.⟧ In Auto mode, a shell command runs without review only when every command in it matches an allowlist entry, and anything else asks you first. Permission rules read each word the way bash passes arguments to a program during parsing, ensuring that command splitting matches actual execution exactly. To avoid interrupting workflow, querying compiler versions with `make --version`, `cmake --version`, and `just --version` is now allowed to run directly by default without manual confirmation.

items.original:
Auto mode runs a shell command without review only when every command in it matches an allowlist entry; anything else asks first. Permission rules read each word the way bash passes it to the program
Auto mode runs `make --version`, `cmake --version`, and `just --version` without asking

title.zh-TW: 沙盒禁用工作樹時預先隱藏選項，指令操作直接回絕
title.en: Options Are Hidden When Sandboxes Disallow Worktrees, with Commands Refused Up Front

body.zh-TW: 身處受限的沙盒環境開發專案，不符權限的進階功能現在會更早被辨識並阻擋。⟦走進主題樂園的遊樂設施，以前限制身高的項目依然排在推薦看板上，排到入口才被工作人員勸退；現在導覽螢幕會先隱藏不符規定的項目，若直接持通行證感應，閘門也會當場顯示限制說明。⟧當沙盒設定檔不允許建立工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，介面與指令會同步連動。在 `/fork`、`/new` 與歡迎畫面中，建立工作樹的選項會隱藏。如果你手動執行 `grok -w`、`grok worktree create`，或是發起工作樹分叉與子代理工作樹，指令會在第一時間直接回絕，並明確顯示沙盒拒絕訊息。
body.en: When developing projects inside a restricted sandbox environment, advanced features that exceed permissions are now identified and blocked earlier. ⟦At a theme park attraction, height-restricted rides once remained on the recommendation board, turning guests away only after they queued to the entrance; now guide screens hide ineligible rides in advance, and tapping a pass at the turnstile immediately displays the restriction notice.⟧ When a sandbox profile does not allow creating a worktree (a Git feature that lets a single project run multiple copies in parallel), the interface and commands respond in tandem. Worktree options are hidden in `/fork`, `/new`, and the Welcome screen. If you manually run `grok -w` or `grok worktree create`, or initiate worktree forks and subagent worktrees, the commands refuse up front and clearly display the sandbox refusal message.

items.original:
`grok -w`, `grok worktree create`, worktree forks, and subagent worktrees refuse up front with the sandbox refusal message when the sandbox profile does not allow creating worktrees
Worktree options are hidden in `/fork`, `/new`, and the Welcome screen when the sandbox profile does not allow creating worktrees

title.zh-TW: 工作樹命名支援萬國碼字元，防範重名並修正檔案排除規則
title.en: Worktree Naming Supports Unicode Characters, Prevents Duplicates, and Fixes File Exclusion Rules

body.zh-TW:
利用工作樹（Git 平行開多份專案副本的功能）切換任務時，命名檢驗與檔案追蹤邏輯迎來一系列完善。⟦檢索檔案室裡的分類公文夾，以前標籤上的外文重音符號常被系統抹除，遇上重名還會自動亂加尾綴編號；現在系統忠實保留外文字元，一旦重名便立刻提醒，手動清空的舊編號也能重新指派。⟧

使用 `Ctrl+W` 輸入工作樹名稱時，現在會完整保留如 `café` 這類萬國碼字元；若名稱或參照以減號 `-` 開頭，或是名稱已被占用，系統會直接拒絕建立，不再擅自附加數字後綴。先前若手動刪除了工作樹資料夾，其名稱現在也能重新使用。

新工作樹納入檔案時，只要檔案已受版本追蹤，即使符合 `.gitignore` 規則依然會保留；若檔案僅被 `.git/info/exclude` 或全域 `core.excludesFile` 排除，則會排除。
body.en:
When switching tasks using a worktree (a Git feature that lets a project run multiple copies in parallel), naming validation and file tracking logic receive a series of refinements. ⟦Think of searching through categorized document folders in an archive: foreign accent marks on labels were once stripped away and duplicate names triggered random numbered suffixes; now the system faithfully retains foreign characters, alerts you immediately upon a naming conflict, and lets you reassign previously discarded numbers.⟧

Worktree names typed with `Ctrl+W` now fully keep Unicode letters such as `café`; if a name or ref starts with a minus sign `-`, or if the name is already taken, the system refuses creation directly instead of attaching a numbered suffix. If you previously deleted a worktree folder by hand, its name can now be used again.

When a new worktree brings in files, tracked files that match `.gitignore` rules are still kept; files excluded only by `.git/info/exclude` or global `core.excludesFile` are left out.

items.original:
Worktree names typed with `Ctrl+W` keep Unicode letters such as `café`, and a name or ref that starts with `-` is refused
New worktrees keep tracked files that match `.gitignore`, and leave out files excluded only by `.git/info/exclude` or `core.excludesFile`
A worktree name you type that is already taken is refused instead of getting a numbered suffix, and a name whose folder you deleted by hand can be used again

title.zh-TW: 恢復指令支援自動載入更多對話，啟動失敗保留已輸入文字
title.en: Resume Command Automatically Loads Older Sessions, and Preserves Typed Input on Launch Failure

body.zh-TW: 在不同工作階段（session，指與 AI 互動的獨立對話流程）之間切換或開啟新任務，操作體驗有了更貼心的防護。⟦查閱檔案櫃中的活頁備忘錄，以前翻到夾層底部就無法再看更早的紀錄，抽換新活頁時若卡住，剛寫下的文字還會整頁遺失；現在翻到底端會自動接續附上舊紀錄並註明已展開數量，抽換新頁失敗時也會把原稿完整退回。⟧以往輸入 `/resume` 挑選歷史對話時，畫面只會列出固定筆數；現在只要捲動到選單最後一列，系統便會自動載入更早以前的工作階段，並清楚顯示目前已載入的總數量。如果你嘗試開啟新工作階段卻不幸啟動失敗，先前在輸入框中打好的一長串文字不會遺失，而是會如實還原到返回後的輸入提示列中，方便你直接重試或修改。
body.en: Switching between different sessions (independent conversation flows for interacting with AI) or launching new tasks now comes with more thoughtful safeguards. ⟦Inside a filing cabinet of loose-leaf memos, flipping to the bottom previously prevented viewing older records, and a snag while inserting a new page would lose everything just written; now reaching the bottom automatically appends earlier records with a count of loaded entries, and a failed page insertion returns the original draft intact.⟧ Previously, entering `/resume` to pick from past conversations listed only a fixed number of entries; now, reaching the last row of the menu automatically loads older sessions and clearly shows how many sessions are currently loaded. If you attempt to start a new session and it fails to launch, what you typed in the input box is not lost, but returned to the prompt you return to so you can easily retry or make edits.

items.original:
`/resume` loads older sessions when you reach the last row, and shows how many sessions are loaded
A new session that fails to start puts what you typed back in the prompt you return to, instead of losing it

title.zh-TW: HTTP 連線與遠端 MCP 伺服器可接受四種壓縮回應
title.en: HTTP Connections and Remote MCP Servers Accept Four Compressed Response Formats

body.zh-TW: AI 藉由網路呼叫遠端伺服器或外部擴充時，對方回傳的資料可能採用壓縮格式。⟦收發跨國快遞包裹，寄件方可以用不同方式壓縮包裹體積，收件窗口則需要備有對應的拆包工具；現在窗口能接收四種指定包裝，不必要求寄件方一律使用同一種。⟧現在所有的 HTTP（網路傳送請求與回應的通訊規則）連線，都能接收 gzip、brotli、zstd 與 deflate 這四種格式的壓縮回應。這也包含遠端 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器在內。
body.en: When an AI calls remote servers or external extensions over the network, incoming data may arrive in compressed formats. ⟦When handling international courier parcels, senders could compress package volume using various techniques while the receiving desk needed matching unpacking tools; now the counter accepts four designated packaging types without forcing every sender to use the exact same one.⟧ Now all HTTP (communication rules for sending network requests and responses) connections can accept compressed responses in gzip, brotli, zstd, and deflate formats. This includes remote MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers as well.

items.original: HTTP connections, including remote MCP servers, accept gzip, brotli, zstd, and deflate compressed responses

title.zh-TW: 停用外掛設定生效時，輸入框上方不再顯示安裝推薦
title.en: Setting Plugin Disabling Turns Off Installation Suggestions Above the Prompt

body.zh-TW: 專注在終端機中編寫程式碼時，輸入框上方不時跳出的擴充推薦容易打斷輸入視線。⟦租用專注工作的獨立隔音艙，以前牆面上總貼滿各類器材租借與升級服務的推銷傳單；現在只要登記免打擾模式，艙內便只保留工作檯燈，任何周邊服務的宣傳單一律清空。⟧當你指定 `disable_plugins = true` 後，輸入提示列上方就不會再主動跳出任何外掛安裝建議，讓終端機視野始終保持乾淨集中。
body.en: When focusing on writing code in the terminal, extension recommendations that pop up above the prompt can easily break your concentration. ⟦Imagine a rented soundproof focus booth: walls were once plastered with flyers advertising equipment rentals and service upgrades; now registering for do-not-disturb mode leaves only the desk lamp lit, clearing away all promotional flyers for peripheral services.⟧ Once you set `disable_plugins = true`, plugin install suggestions will no longer appear above the prompt, keeping your terminal view clean and focused.

items.original: Plugin install suggestions above the prompt are off when `disable_plugins = true` is set

title.zh-TW: 網路搜尋支援外部登入首輪查詢，自訂模型對話不再中斷
title.en: Web Search Supports First-Turn Queries with External Logins, and Custom Model Turns Keep Going

body.zh-TW: 請 AI 透過網路搜尋即時資料時，外部帳號驗證與模型介面的穩定性獲得了重要修正。⟦撥打專業機構的諮詢專線，以前透過外部機構代為驗證身分時，第一通電話或交由助理轉接都會連線失敗，總機遇到查詢空檔還會直接切斷；現在系統一撥通就能立刻聯網查詢，即使訊號暫時沒有動作也會保持通話繼續進行。⟧當搜尋模型使用外部驗證提供者登入時，現在從工作階段（指與 AI 互動的獨立對話流程）的第一輪對話開始，以及在指派的子代理中，網路搜尋功能都能正常運作。在 Responses API 上呼叫自訂模型時，若網路搜尋呼叫在啟動時未帶有任何動作，對話輪次現在會保持繼續進行，避免流程意外中斷。
body.en: When asking AI to search the web for real-time information, the reliability of external account authentication and model interfaces receives key fixes. ⟦Dialing a specialized consultation hotline, authenticating through an outside agency previously failed on the first call or when forwarded to an assistant, and the switchboard hung up during query pauses; now dialing connects instantly to online lookup, and the call stays active even when a signal is temporarily idle.⟧ When the search model signs in through an external auth provider, web search works from the first turn of a session (an independent conversation flow for interacting with AI), as well as in assigned subagents. When calling custom models on the Responses API, if a web search call starts without an action, the conversation turn now keeps going to avoid unexpected interruptions.

items.original:
Web search works from the first turn of a session, and in subagents, when the search model signs in through an external auth provider
Custom models on the Responses API keep the turn going when a web search call starts without an action

title.zh-TW: 修復遠端連線按鍵檢查卡死，相容 zsh 啟動設定別名
title.en: Remote Key Check Freezes Are Fixed, with Support for zsh Startup File Aliases

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端終端機連線或使用自訂 Shell 配置，特殊執行環境的相容度迎來關鍵修復。⟦調度偏遠觀測站的自動望遠鏡，以前透過純文字終端遠端連線時，只要一偵測控制面板按鍵狀態就會無預警停擺，自訂的輔助快速鍵更會干擾觀測指令；現在控制程式能正確適應無螢幕的遠距連線，即使技術員設定了專用簡稱，所有排程指令也能準確執行。⟧在沒有圖形介面工作階段（例如透過 SSH 登入）的 macOS 上執行 Grok 時，系統不再於第一次檢查輔助按鍵時卡死。若你的 zsh 啟動設定檔為 `grep` 建立了別名，或是替換了系統內建的 `run-help` 說明函式，終端機執行各項 shell 指令時現在都能正確執行，確保個人化工作環境不受干擾。
body.en: Connecting over a remote terminal or using custom Shell configurations brings critical compatibility fixes for specialized environments. ⟦Managing an automated telescope at a remote observatory, connecting over a text-only terminal previously froze without warning during control-panel key detection, while custom shortcut keys disrupted observation commands; now the control software smoothly handles display-free remote links, executing all scheduled instructions accurately even with technician-defined shorthand.⟧ Running Grok on macOS without a GUI session (such as when logging in over SSH) no longer hangs on its first modifier-key check. If your zsh startup files alias `grep` or replace the built-in `run-help` helper function, terminal execution of shell commands now runs correctly, ensuring personalized work environments remain uninterrupted.

items.original:
Grok on macOS without a GUI session, such as over SSH, no longer hangs on its first modifier-key check
Shell commands run correctly on zsh when your startup files alias `grep` or replace `run-help`

title.zh-TW: 語音聽寫預覽隨說話動態展開，最新字詞始終保持在視野內
title.en: Voice Dictation Preview Expands Dynamically as You Speak, Keeping Newest Words in View

body.zh-TW: 習慣對著麥克風用說話方式指派工作，語音輸入的文字呈現迎來了全新調整。⟦速記員在長捲軸打字機上記錄發言，以前紙捲卡在固定窗口，打字員得頻繁手動拉紙才能確認剛剛打出的段落；現在紙捲會隨著敲擊即時平順延伸，剛印出的文字始終落在最醒目的對焦線中央。⟧現在使用語音聽寫（Voice dictation）時，輸入框內的預覽文字會隨著你開口說話即時增長展開，並始終將最新辨識出的單詞保持在可視範圍內。當你正在整理複雜思路、連續說出一長串需求時，目光再也不必在輸入欄位中來回搜尋，只要盯著最新出現的語句，就能確認語音辨識是否精確，省去手動向下捲動查看的麻煩。
body.en: For those accustomed to assigning tasks by speaking into a microphone, the text display for speech input receives a brand-new update. ⟦A stenographer recording remarks on a continuous scroll typewriter was once constrained by a fixed window, requiring constant manual paper pulling to review typed passages; now the scroll unrolls smoothly in real time with each keystroke, keeping newly printed words centered on the primary focus line.⟧ When using Voice dictation, the preview text inside the prompt grows dynamically as you speak, keeping the newest recognized words continuously in view. As you organize complex thoughts and dictate a long series of requests, you no longer have to scan back and forth across the input field; tracking the newest incoming phrases lets you verify speech recognition accuracy without the hassle of manually scrolling down.

items.original: Voice dictation preview grows the prompt as you speak and keeps the newest words in view

title.zh-TW: 記憶庫固定採用簡潔索引，指令依讀取頻率排序列出主題
title.en: Memory Always Uses a Concise Index, and the Command Lists Topics Sorted by Read Frequency

body.zh-TW: 當你在長期的對話中累積了大量專案筆記，隨時想掌握 AI 記住了哪些關鍵資訊。⟦走進設有熱門書專架的圖書館，以前目錄需要額外開關才會縮減，找主題得逐行翻閱；現在架上只保留書名與索書號，翻閱率最高的書籍一進門就能看到。⟧記憶功能現在固定採用只記錄主題標題與路徑的簡潔版 `MEMORY.md` 索引。過去在設定檔中用來啟用精簡索引的 `[memory_v2] compact_index_enabled` 選項已經不再生效。在終端機輸入 `/memory` 查看時，清單會直接依照 Grok 讀取各主題的頻繁程度排序。平日整理資料或規劃旅遊行程時，只要輸入 `/memory`，就能優先瀏覽最常被引用的核心筆記。
body.en: When you have accumulated a large volume of project notes over long-term conversations, you want to keep track of the key information the AI remembers at any time. ⟦Step into a library with a popular book display: previously, the catalog required an extra toggle to condense and finding a topic meant browsing line by line; now the shelves keep only book titles and call numbers, and the most frequently read books can be seen right as you walk in.⟧ Memory now always uses the concise `MEMORY.md` index that records only topic titles and paths. The `[memory_v2] compact_index_enabled` setting previously used in the configuration file to enable the concise index no longer has an effect. When you type `/memory` in the terminal to view it, the list is directly sorted by how frequently Grok reads each topic. When organizing information or planning a travel itinerary in daily work, simply enter `/memory` to browse the most frequently referenced core notes first.

items.original: Memory always uses the concise `MEMORY.md` index of topic titles and paths, and `/memory` lists topics by how often Grok reads them. The `[memory_v2] compact_index_enabled` setting no longer has an effect

title.zh-TW: Rex 終端機獨立回報各工作階段與子代理，支援只顯示主狀態
title.en: Rex Terminal Reports Each Session and Subagent Independently, Supporting Main Status Only Display

body.zh-TW:
使用 Rex 終端機同時進行多項任務時，常常需要隨時確認所有背景助理的運作情況。⟦大樓中央監控室替每項勤務與正在巡邏的巡邏員各留一筆獨立紀錄，也能選擇只回報主要狀態。⟧Rex 終端機支援現在會將每個開啟的工作階段，以及每位正在執行的子代理分別回報為獨立紀錄，方便你清楚掌握各自的即時動態。如果你不希望介面過於繁雜、只想回報主要的整體狀態，可以在設定檔中將子項目回報關閉：

```toml
[ui.notifications.program_status]
children = false
```

儲存後，狀態通知便只會保留主要狀態，不再列出所有個別子代理。
body.en:
When using Rex terminal to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, you often need to check the operational status of all background assistants at any time. ⟦Picture a building's central monitoring room that keeps an independent record for each duty and each patrolling guard, with the option to report only the main status.⟧ Rex terminal support now reports each open session and each running subagent as its own record, making it easy for you to track what each one is doing in real time. If you prefer to avoid clutter and only report the overall primary status, you can turn off child reporting in the configuration file:

```toml
[ui.notifications.program_status]
children = false
```

After saving, status notifications will keep only the main status and no longer list all individual subagents.

items.original: Rex terminal support reports each open session and each running subagent as its own record, so Rex shows what each one is doing. Set `children = false` under `[ui.notifications.program_status]` to report only the main status

title.zh-TW: 工作樹操作增加清楚指引，目錄丟失提示修復且非 Git 環境主動說明
title.en: Worktree Operations Add Clear Guidance, Prompting Repairs for Missing Directories and Proactively Explaining Non-Git Environments

body.zh-TW:
在多個分支之間頻繁切換或整理專案副本時，工作樹的目錄狀態有時會因為搬移而出現異常。Grok 支援的工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）現在針對常見的異常狀況提供了更清楚的說明。⟦翻開設備租借處的巡檢紀錄，以前在不支援的區域申請登記，系統毫無說明讓人摸不著頭緒；箱子遺失或總庫搬遷時，清單也不提供找回方法；現在未成功會明白說明原因，資料夾遺失或位置變更時更會主動附上修復步驟。⟧

當你在非 Git 專案目錄下執行 `grok -w` 或按下快速鍵 `Ctrl+W` 時，畫面會明確解釋因為目前不在 Git 版本庫中，所以並未建立任何工作樹。

如果你先前建立的工作樹資料夾已經被刪除，或是來源版本庫移動了位置，執行 `grok worktree list` 與 `grok worktree show` 時會清楚標記這筆異常紀錄，並提示修復工作樹的具體做法。
body.en:
When frequently switching between multiple branches or organizing project copies, directory states for worktrees can sometimes become abnormal due to being moved. Worktrees (a Git feature for opening multiple copies of the same project in parallel) supported by Grok now provide clearer explanations for common abnormal situations. ⟦Flip through the inspection log at an equipment rental desk: previously, applying for registration in an unsupported area gave no explanation and left you bewildered, and the checklist offered no recovery method when a case was missing or the main storage relocated; now unfulfilled attempts clearly state the reason, and missing folders or changed locations proactively include repair steps.⟧

When you run `grok -w` or press the shortcut key `Ctrl+W` in a non-Git project directory, the screen clearly explains that no worktree was created because you are not currently in a Git repository.

If a worktree folder you previously created has been deleted, or the source repository moved, running `grok worktree list` and `grok worktree show` will clearly mark this abnormal record with a hint on how to repair the worktree.

items.original:
`grok worktree list` and `grok worktree show` mark a worktree whose folder is missing or whose source repository moved, with a hint on how to repair it
`grok -w` and `Ctrl+W` explain that no worktree was made when you run them outside a git repository

title.zh-TW: 命令掛鉤支援參數清單，無須外殼環境直接執行並自動代入變數
title.en: Command Hooks Support an Argument List, Running Directly Without a Shell and Automatically Filling Variables

body.zh-TW: 撰寫自動化流程來攔截特定事件時，直接透過命令列傳遞參數往往比呼叫命令解譯器更安全乾淨。Grok 的指令掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在正式支援在設定中填寫 `args` 引數清單。⟦搭乘直達專車前往指定目的地，包裹直接交給指定程式派送，不經轉運站轉手；每件包裹標籤上預留的欄位，也會在出發前逐一填入這趟的資料。⟧設定 `args` 後，Grok 會將 `command` 視為單一獨立程式直接執行，完全不再透過外殼環境解譯。每個引數內部若包含 `$GROK_SESSION_ID` 等掛鉤變數，執行時都會自動代入當前工作階段的實際數值。當你想在對話結束時將資訊傳給外部日誌，只要在掛鉤設定填入 `args`，就能直接傳送乾淨的參數。
body.en: When writing automated workflows to intercept specific events, passing arguments directly through the command line is often safer and cleaner than invoking a command interpreter. Grok's command hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) now officially support configuring an `args` list in settings. ⟦Take a direct express shuttle to a designated destination: packages are handed straight to designated programs for delivery without passing through a transfer station, and reserved fields on each package label are filled in with this trip's data before departure.⟧ After setting `args`, Grok executes `command` directly as a single standalone program with no shell interpretation. If an argument contains hook variables such as `$GROK_SESSION_ID`, the actual value of the current session is automatically substituted at runtime. When you want to send information to external logs at the end of a conversation, simply configure `args` in the hook settings to pass clean arguments directly.

items.original: Command hooks accept an `args` list: Grok runs `command` as one program with those arguments and no shell, and fills hook variables such as `$GROK_SESSION_ID` in each argument

title.zh-TW: 計畫審查介面自動保留輸入文字，並等待未完成的提示與視窗關閉
title.en: Plan Review Interface Automatically Preserves Typed Text and Waits for Pending Prompts and Windows to Close

body.zh-TW:
專心在對話框裡敲擊鍵盤或填寫回饋時，最怕畫面突然彈出確認選單而打亂思緒。⟦主管拿公文來簽核時，你正在寫的草稿會留下當作審批備註，筆下的字也不會變成批准蓋章；若是工作告一段落才送來的簽核，則會等你關閉手邊列出的對話或編輯介面，再呈上文件。⟧

當你在輸入文字的當下彈出計畫審查畫面，你方才鍵入的文字會完整保留在審查附註中，輸入的字元再也不會誤觸如 approve 這類批准快捷鍵。

而在對話輪次結束時，如果畫面上仍開啟著 `/feedback` 回饋視窗、提問對話、等待你回應的工具操作提示，或是正在排隊的提示詞編輯，計畫審查畫面會確實等待你關閉這些視窗後才開啟。
body.en:
When concentrating on typing in the chat box or filling out feedback, the last thing you want is a confirmation pop-up disrupting your thoughts. ⟦When a manager brings documents for sign-off, the draft you are currently writing is kept as approval notes rather than turning your written words into an approval stamp; if the sign-off arrives only after a task milestone, it waits until you close the open conversations or editing interfaces before presenting the papers.⟧

When a plan review screen pops up while you are typing, the text you just entered is fully preserved in the review notes, so typed characters no longer accidentally trigger plan shortcuts such as approve.

At the end of a turn, if the screen still has an open `/feedback` dialog, question prompt, tool prompt waiting for your response, or queued prompt edit, the plan review screen will faithfully wait until you close those windows before opening.

items.original:
Plan reviews that open while you are typing keep your text in the review notes, so a typed letter no longer triggers a plan shortcut such as approve
Plan reviews at the end of a turn wait until you close an open `/feedback` dialog, question, tool prompt, or queued prompt edit

title.zh-TW: 分流指令保留母工作階段的模型與思考力度
title.en: The Fork Command Preserves the Model and Effort of the Parent Session

body.zh-TW: 當你針對複雜架構展開深入探討，在中途想分支出另一個思路來驗證不同想法。⟦抽取樣品分裝到另一支試管進行對照實驗時，分支試管會保留母樣品指定的試劑與控溫檔位，沿用這兩項條件繼續測試。⟧如果最初啟動 Grok 時透過 `-m` 指定了模型，或使用 `--effort` 設定了思考力度，現在執行 `/fork` 分流指令時，新分支會完整保留母工作階段的模型與思考力度設定。你在終端機啟動自訂模型並深入除錯到一半時，只要打 `/fork`，就能立刻在維持原有設定的狀態下接續對話，不必再手動重新調整參數。
body.en: When conducting an in-depth exploration into a complex architecture, you may want to branch into another line of thought midway to validate different ideas. ⟦In a laboratory dividing a sample into another test tube for a control experiment, the branch tube preserves the reagents and temperature settings specified for the parent sample, continuing the test under both conditions.⟧ If Grok was initially started by specifying a model with `-m` or setting thinking effort with `--effort`, running the `/fork` command now preserves the model and effort settings from the parent session. When you launch a custom model in the terminal and are halfway through intensive debugging, simply running `/fork` allows you to immediately continue the conversation under the original settings without manually readjusting parameters.

items.original: `/fork` keeps the model and effort from the parent session when Grok was started with `-m` or `--effort`

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型使用 Chat Completions 連接 MCP 時，不再因工具結構定義錯誤中斷對話
title.en: Custom Models Connecting to MCP over Chat Completions No Longer Fail Turns Due to Tool Schema Errors

body.zh-TW: 把自己的語言模型串接到相容介面時，常會搭配各種延伸外掛來擴充檔案讀取或搜尋能力。⟦拿著轉接插頭連接外接擴充座，原本會碰到的接頭規格問題可能讓使用中斷；修好這個問題後，就不再被同一個原因打斷。⟧自訂模型使用 Chat Completions 端點（模型接收對話請求的介面）。連接 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，不再因工具結構定義錯誤而讓該輪對話失敗。
body.en: When connecting your own language model to a compatible interface, you often pair it with various extensions to expand file reading or search capabilities. ⟦Connect to an external docking station with an adapter: connector specification issues that previously caused disruptions might halt operations; with this issue resolved, you are no longer cut off for the same reason.⟧ Custom models use Chat Completions endpoints (the interface where models receive chat requests). When connecting to MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers, turns no longer fail due to tool schema errors.

items.original: Custom models on Chat Completions endpoints no longer fail turns with a tool schema error when MCP servers are connected

title.zh-TW: 窄版終端機自動隱藏即時狀態，工作流程畫面完整保留代理名稱
title.en: Narrower Terminals Automatically Hide Live Status, Keeping Agent Names Intact in Workflow Run Views

body.zh-TW: 在筆記型電腦的小螢幕或將終端機分割成多個小窗格時，水平顯示寬度往往非常有限。⟦抬頭看狹窄月台上的動態顯示看板，以前版面硬要塞入詳細的進度描述，導致重要的車次名稱被硬生生切掉半截；現在空間不足時會自動收起即時動態文字，優先保證每一班列車的名稱完整顯示。⟧檢視工作流程執行畫面時，如果在寬度較窄的終端機視窗中瀏覽，畫面現在會自動隱藏各個代理的即時狀態文字。這避免了狀態描述佔滿版面而把代理名稱擠出螢幕，讓你在窄視窗下也能一眼認清正在運作的每個代理。
body.en: On small laptop screens or when splitting the terminal into multiple small panes, horizontal display width is often quite limited. ⟦Glance up at an electronic departures board on a narrow train platform: previously, the display crammed in detailed progress descriptions and abruptly cut train service names in half; now, when space is constrained, live status text collapses automatically to ensure every train's name is displayed in full.⟧ When viewing workflow run views in a narrower terminal window, the screen now automatically hides the live status text for each agent. This prevents status descriptions from crowding the layout and pushing agent names off the screen, allowing you to clearly identify each running agent at a glance even in narrow windows.

items.original: Workflow run views hide live status text for each agent on narrower terminals, so agent names are no longer cut off

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

items.original:
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: /resume 精確比對單一工作階段直接開啟，選單支援任意詞序搜尋
title.en: /resume Directly Resumes an Exact Single-Session Match and Supports Any-Word-Order Search in the Picker

body.zh-TW: 當你累積了大量對話紀錄想重新接續進度時，不必再忍受死板的關鍵字順序或多餘的確認步驟。⟦翻找辦公室抽屜裡的專案夾時，以前封面標題上的單字順序只要顛倒就翻不出來，就算報出唯一編號也非得拉開整個清單；現在只要寫齊關鍵字無論順序都能對應，代碼剛好只吻合一份時更能直接抽取出夾。⟧現在在終端機輸入 `/resume <id or name>` 時，只要指定的 ID 或標題剛好只吻合單一工作階段，Grok Build 就會直接進入該工作階段，不再每次都強制彈出挑選器讓你多點一次。如果呼叫挑選器手動尋找，只要輸入的內容包含標題中的每一個單字，無論先後順序為何，挑選器都能精確列出符合的工作階段。
body.en: When you have accumulated a large conversation history and want to resume progress, you no longer have to endure rigid keyword ordering or redundant confirmation steps. ⟦Picture someone searching for a project folder in an office drawer. Previously, if the word order on the cover was reversed, it could not be found, and reciting a unique number still required opening the entire list. Now, entering all keywords matches regardless of sequence, and matching exactly one code lets you pull the folder straight out.⟧ Now when you enter `/resume <id or name>` in the terminal, as long as the specified ID or title matches exactly one session, Grok Build directly enters that session instead of forcing a picker popup every time for an extra click. If you bring up the picker to search manually, the picker accurately lists matching sessions as long as your input includes every word in the title, regardless of their order.

items.original:
Resume picker finds sessions whose titles contain every word you type, in any order
`/resume <id or name>` opens the session directly when the ID or title matches exactly one session, instead of always opening the picker

title.zh-TW: 儀表板預覽文字支援滑鼠拖曳，放開即自動複製到剪貼簿
title.en: Dashboard Preview Text Supports Mouse Dragging, Automatically Copying to the Clipboard on Release

body.zh-TW: 想要從儀表板快速擷取一段預覽內容轉貼給同事時，現在不需要再按任何鍵盤快捷鍵。⟦拿著螢光筆在文件上劃記重點時，以前畫完標記還得手動按相機快門留底；現在筆尖劃過文字並在放開筆桿時，內容就自動傳送至隨身筆記。⟧在儀表板檢視預覽文字時，你可以直接按住滑鼠游標拖曳選取想要的字串。只要在選取完成後放開滑鼠按鍵，被標記的文字片段就會自動複製到剪貼簿。無論是需要摘錄報錯內容還是比對執行結果，拖曳選取後就能直接切換到其他對話視窗貼上，省下反白後還要按鍵複製的瑣碎手續。
body.en: When you want to quickly grab preview content from the dashboard to paste for a colleague, you no longer need to press any keyboard shortcuts. ⟦Imagine marking highlights on a document with a highlighter. Previously, after finishing the mark, you still had to press a camera shutter manually to keep a record; now, as the pen tip glides across the text and releases, the content is transmitted automatically to a pocket notebook.⟧ While viewing preview text on the dashboard, you can click and drag the mouse cursor to select the desired string. As soon as you release the mouse button after completing the selection, the marked text snippet is automatically copied to the clipboard. Whether you need to extract error details or compare execution results, you can paste directly into another chat window right after dragging to select, saving the tedious step of pressing keys to copy after highlighting.

items.original: Dashboard peek text can be selected by dragging over it with the mouse, and the selection is copied to the clipboard when you release

title.zh-TW: 工作流程檢視向下滾動名冊時，畫面持續朝較新代理人平順推進
title.en: Workflow View Smoothly Advances Toward Newer Agents When Scrolling Down the Roster

body.zh-TW: 追蹤多個代理人協同運作的工作流程時，檢視進度最怕視窗畫面不聽使喚。⟦順著排隊走道向前推動檢視鏡頭時，以前只要滾輪往下滾動，視野就冷不防被彈簧拉回起點；現在畫面會依循操作，順暢朝著後方新加入的成員推進。⟧在工作流程的執行檢視畫面中，當你在代理人名冊上向下滾動滑鼠滾輪時，畫面現在會順著操作方向持續朝向較新的代理人捲動，而不是突然彈回原處。這讓你在依序盤點每個代理人的最新執行進度時，視野能夠一路平穩跟隨，不必反覆重新尋找焦點。
body.en: When tracking a workflow where multiple agents collaborate, the biggest frustration when checking progress is an uncooperative viewport. ⟦Think of tracking an inspection camera forward along a queue corridor. Previously, whenever the scroll wheel moved downward, the view was abruptly pulled back to the starting point like a spring; now, the frame follows the action, smoothly advancing toward newly joined members at the rear.⟧ In the workflow execution view, when you scroll down on the agent roster with the mouse wheel, the view now continuously scrolls toward newer agents in the direction of your movement, rather than snapping back to the origin. This allows your line of sight to smoothly follow along as you inspect each agent's latest execution progress in sequence, without having to repeatedly hunt for focus.

items.original: Workflow run views scroll toward newer agents when you wheel down the agent roster, instead of snapping back

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行掛鉤失敗時點名未啟動的程式，不再誤指指令碼出錯
title.en: Windows Identifies Unstarted Programs When Hook Execution Fails, Rather Than Blaming the Script

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下使用掛鉤（在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）除錯自動化流程時，最怕看到語意模糊的錯誤訊息。⟦呼叫外勤車隊出門執行任務時，以前只要外包貨車在門口無法發動，控制台卻只會回報派工單寫錯；現在通報會明確點名是哪一輛車發動失敗，不再冤枉原本寫好的任務清單。⟧在 Windows 系統中若掛鉤產生行程失敗，終端機現在會直接點名究竟是哪個外部程式無法啟動，例如具體標示出 PowerShell 或 Git Bash 發生錯誤，而不是怪罪掛鉤指令稿本身。面對這類問題時，你能立刻看出是環境缺少執行工具還是路徑設定遺漏，省下逐行檢查指令碼內容的時間。
body.en: When debugging automated workflows on Windows using hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), the worst experience is seeing ambiguous error messages. ⟦Dispatching a field fleet for a mission previously meant that whenever an outsourced truck failed to start at the gate, the control center only reported an error in the work order; now, the alert clearly names which vehicle failed to start without falsely blaming the original task list.⟧ If a hook fails to spawn a process on Windows, the terminal now directly names which external program failed to start, such as specifically indicating an error in PowerShell or Git Bash, rather than blaming the hook script itself. When confronting such issues, you can immediately tell whether the environment lacks an execution tool or is missing a path configuration, saving time spent inspecting the script line by line.

items.original: Hook spawn failures on Windows name the program that failed to start, such as PowerShell or Git Bash, instead of blaming the hook script
